tone.target: gritty edge-of-breakup indie rock crunch with slight fuzz texture
tone.profile: gritty edge-of-breakup indie rock crunch with slight fuzz texture
tone.summary: The chain uses an OD pedal for initial crunch, followed by a Fuzz distortion to add the required gritty edge. The UK 50 amp model provides the classic Marshall/Vox voicing, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet for a dry, upfront indie rock sound.
